  Dennis McCullough, PAA Cycling Club

  Thomas Beachlman, Sierra Madres resident
  David Zaitz, San Gabriel resident

  Anthony Rose, Pasadena resident, spoke on noise pollution in his
  neighborhood, specifically church bells through megaphones and
  grocery trucks that play loud music, and asked the City for
  assistance in lowering the noise levels.

  Compliance will follow up with Mr. Rose to address his concerns.

  recommendation, however, he requested that staff provide a
